<div class="card-body">
'''Leia's Sporting Blaster''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レイアの護身用ブラスター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、レイアに配備する。２フォース消費して、それ以外の戦士に配備する。起動にフォースを消費しない。運命数を引く。キャラクターなら、運命数－１＞能力値で、ビークルなら運命数－１＞回避値か装甲値で命中する。レイアが命中させた場合、対象の没収値は０になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-156o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ドリアリアン・ディフェンス・コングロマリット製の、護身狩猟ブラスター。護身及び、小規模の狩猟用。射程が短くパワーも低い。５０発分のエネルギーを内蔵。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Leia's Self-Defense Blaster.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on Leia, or 2 Force to deploy on another warrior. Fire at no Force cost. Draw destiny. Hit a character if destiny −1 exceeds ability, or a vehicle if destiny −1 exceeds maneuver or armor. If Leia hits the target, its forfeit becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' A defense and hunting blaster made by the Drearian Defense Conglomerate. Intended for self-defense and small-scale hunting. It has short range, low power, and energy for 50 shots.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Leia's Sporting Blaster]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
